verdict.rationale: Clerky is a legal-paperwork and formation SaaS with no built-in AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is outside its product role. The evidence shows Clerky only in the opposite role: it publishes its own remote MCP server for Claude and ChatGPT to connect to. That server-side capability belongs to a different story and does not make this client axis applicable.
